timeline.event: checkout config_v42 deployed with EU tax endpoint mapping change
tax service request failed: region mismatch for eu-order
retry failed: tax endpoint us-east cannot serve eu tax quote
incident detected: EU checkout requests failing with tax calculation errors

root_cause: Endpoint misrouting due to incorrect EU tax endpoint mapping in checkout config_v42
why_it_happened: Checkout config_v42 was deployed with a change that switched EU tax endpoint mapping
The new endpoint mapping incorrectly routed EU tax requests to us-east endpoint which cannot serve EU tax quotes
This caused region mismatch errors and EU checkout requests to fail
ruled_out_hypotheses: Payment gateway outage (would affect both EU and US checkout traffic)
Database pool exhaustion (presents as pool timeout saturation, not region mismatch)
immediate_mitigation: Rollback checkout config to the last known good version (config_v41)
